title: Commits by organization
description: Commits by the domain of the author's email address, added up across the repositories. An organization's commits in the last 12 months are those of the 12 months that end with each repository's last commit. A domain only one person commits from is counted apart, as are mail providers anyone can sign up for, code hosts' private noreply addresses and bots. A domain says where an address is, not who paid for the work.
